kebab_example: aliyun pds audit-log-export --query acted_at_2025-03-10T16:00:00_and_acted_at_2025-03-17T15:59:59 --order-by acted_at_DESC --file-name 2024-01-log.csv --biz-language zh_CN --region cn-hangzhou
name: AuditLogExport

parameters.help_en: The name of the exported file. The name can be up to 1,024 characters in length. The default value is `log.csv`
parameters.help_zh: 导出的文件名，长度不超过1024。默认为log.csv
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en:
The language of the exported file. Default: zh_CN (Chinese). Valid values:

`zh_CN`: Chinese

`en_US`: English
parameters.help_zh:
导出语言，默认中文。支持参数：

zh_CN（中文）
en_US（英文）
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en:
The sort field. You can sort by the operation time (`acted_at`). If this parameter is not specified, the results are sorted by operation time in descending order. Valid values:

`acted_at DESC`: Sorts by operation time in descending order.

`acted_at ASC`: Sorts by operation time in ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段，支持操作时间（acted_at）排序。默认值：空，按照操作时间逆序排序。支持参数：

acted_at DESC（按操作时间逆序）
acted_at ASC（按操作时间正序）
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en:
Query audit logs by using a combination of the following fields:

`drive_id` (string): The drive ID.

`actor_id` (string): The actor ID.

`acted_at` (date): The operation time. The time must be in UTC and specified in the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss` format.

`action_type` (string): The operation type
parameters.help_zh:
支持根据以下字段组合查询：
drive_id（空间ID，string）
actor_id（操作者ID，string）
acted_at（操作时间，date，格式"2006-01-02T00:00:00"，只支持零时区）
action_type（操作类型，string）
parameters.name: query

async_task_id.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous export task
async_task_id.description_zh: 审计日志导出的异步任务 id
